label: verify-bm-ip-landscape-deep

claims.claim: The three building-scale wood-bilayer families are narrow and not obstacles to a printed resin or powder element (ETH/Empa WO2018033422 Ceased, lever-coupled shading; Stuttgart EP4019251 B1 and DE112019001411 pre-condition layers at one climate).
claims.source_says: Manufacturing method of a multi-layer component (1) of layered elements (0, 0'), comprising: obtaining (I) target climatic condition information of a climatic condition at a target location at a customer's site
claims.note: EP4019251 B1 claim 1 and its 2026-03-25 grant mention match, but the WO and DE pages and the Ceased status could not be fetched, and 'not obstacles' is a judgment.

claims.claim: MIT/Stratasys US 11155025 B2 is the live patent nearest a resin-printed differential-swelling part (Active, to about 2034-02-25), claim 1 narrow; the broad parent application is Abandoned.
claims.note: Google Patents returned HTTP 503 on two routes and Justia returned 403, so claim text, status and expiry were not checked.

claims.claim: Zero Google Patents documents and zero arXiv records combine a theorem prover/proof assistant with material, geometry or AM design; nearest are expired Microsoft US 8473895, live PARC IC planner, live Toyota inflatable design method; so a design-and-verification method is the most plausible ownable subject matter.
claims.note: The Google Patents queries and the Microsoft page were unreachable (503/403), and the ownability conclusion is a judgment for counsel.

claims.claim: The optimum-thickness-ratio behaviour and measured wood curvature changes are in a patent document citing Timoshenko 1925, so the bilayer principle cannot be claimed.
claims.note: WO2018033422 on Google Patents returned 503 and Patentscope returned 403, so the Timoshenko passage was not seen.

overall: I could confirm one of the four key claims, and only in part. The EPO server gave EP4019251 B1 claim 1 and the 2026-03-25 grant mention, both as the agent described. Google Patents answered 503 on two routes and Justia and Patentscope answered 403. That left the MIT/Stratasys, Microsoft and WO2018033422 claims unchecked. The theorem-prover search counts could not be re-run, and the 'ownable subject matter' conclusion is a judgment for counsel.
